lines.text: Let's circle back to that after lunch.

data.define: To come back to a topic after other things.

example.text: Let's circle back to that after lunch.

misuse.text: Don't say 'circle back' when you'll ignore it.
misuse.why: People will wait for your reply.

data.l1_hook: Não há tempo agora. 'circle back' depois?
data.l1_ex: Vamos "circle back" nisso depois do almoço.

native.tip: “circle back” = voltar a isso. Exemplo: “Let's circle back to that after lunch.”
